subject.title: Heartbeat skipped reason 'target-none' is misleading when delivery is disabled by default

question: Should the permanent fix preserve `reason: "target-none"` and add a human-readable disabled-delivery hint/status rendering, or rename the machine reason itself?
rationale: Both direct repair directions are plausible, but the machine-readable reason may already be parsed by operators, so automation should not choose the compatibility contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add hint and keep reason
options.body: Preserve `target-none` for compatibility and add a human-readable disabled-delivery explanation to heartbeat last/status surfaces.

options.title: Rename the reason
options.body: Change the machine reason to `delivery-disabled`, accepting possible private-parser compatibility risk for clearer raw JSON.

options.title: Leave output unchanged
options.body: Keep the current raw reason and rely on docs, leaving the reported operator confusion unresolved.

recommendation.title: Add hint and keep reason
recommendation.body: Preserve `target-none` for compatibility and add a human-readable disabled-delivery explanation to heartbeat last/status surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The default-disabled behavior originated in steipete's heartbeat default-none work, and this decision is about that diagnostic contract.
